799ea700b0.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when his grandfather ʿAbd al-Muttalib died?
799ea700b0.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib died when the Prophet ﷺ was eight years old.

4ac4ff9a5d.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when Quraysh rebuilt the Kaʿba and disputed over placing the Black Stone?
4ac4ff9a5d.e: Quraysh rebuilt the Kaʿba when he ﷺ was thirty-five.

137f3892f0.q: What was the name of the Negus who sheltered the emigrants in Abyssinia?
137f3892f0.e: The Negus who sheltered and honoured them was named Ashama.

d140c3c0e3.q: How long were Banu Hashim and Banu al-Muttalib besieged in the valley (al-Shiʿb)?
d140c3c0e3.e: They stayed besieged in the valley for about three years.

2b037d90f3.q: How long was it between the death of Khadija ﵂ and the death of Abu Talib?
2b037d90f3.e: There were three days between the deaths of Khadija and Abu Talib.

34dbe4bb87.q: How many pledged allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ on the night of the Second ʿAqaba?
c: Three hundred and some ten men
34dbe4bb87.e: Seventy-three men and two women pledged allegiance to him on the night of ʿAqaba.

44c760e4b6.q: Who was the guide the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr ﵁ hired to show them the road to Madinah?
44c760e4b6.e: They hired ʿAbd Allah ibn Urayqit, a skilled guide to the Madinah road.

e5d51bf520.q: What reward did Quraysh offer for bringing back the Prophet ﷺ or Abu Bakr ﵁?
e5d51bf520.e: Quraysh offered a hundred camels to whoever brought back either of them.

bef6966adb.q: How many of the Muhajirun (emigrants) fought at Badr?
bef6966adb.e: Eighty-six of the emigrants fought at Badr.

d7c6738de5.q: Which Companion asked the Prophet ﷺ at Badr: “Is this a place Allah commanded you to take, or is it a matter of war and strategy?”
d7c6738de5.e: Al-Hubab ibn al-Mundhir asked him about the camp site at Badr.

c4d08e1d95.q: Which Companion was the foster brother of Kaʿb ibn al-Ashraf and took part in killing him?
c4d08e1d95.e: Abu Naʾila Silkan ibn Salama was Kaʿb's foster brother.

07ac31bfcf.q: For how many nights did the Prophet ﷺ besiege Banu Qaynuqaʿ?
07ac31bfcf.e: He besieged Banu Qaynuqaʿ for fifteen nights until they surrendered to his judgement.

24d2f43386.q: How many archers did ʿAbd Allah ibn Jubayr command at Uhud?
24d2f43386.e: There were fifty archers at Uhud, commanded by ʿAbd Allah ibn Jubayr.

71f73d8bea.q: To which place did Quraysh take Khubayb ibn ʿAdi ﵁ to crucify him?
71f73d8bea.e: They took him to al-Tanʿim to crucify him, and he prayed two rakʿas before he was killed.

263ddef408.q: For how many nights did the Prophet ﷺ besiege Banu Qurayza?
263ddef408.e: He besieged Banu Qurayza for twenty-five nights.

030606f137.q: Which Companion pulled the two rings of the helmet out of the Prophet's face ﷺ at Uhud, losing his own front teeth?
030606f137.e: Abu ʿUbayda ibn al-Jarrah pulled them out with his teeth and lost his two front teeth.

67a20d5e5b.q: Who was the first commander the Prophet ﷺ appointed over the army of Muʾta?
67a20d5e5b.e: The Prophet ﷺ appointed his freedman Zayd ibn Haritha over the expedition to Muʾta.

548fc7e50e.q: How large was the Muslim army with which the Prophet ﷺ set out to conquer Makkah?
548fc7e50e.e: The Prophet ﷺ set out for Makkah with ten thousand fighters.

29dc165f41.q: Who called the adhan from the roof of the Kaʿba on the day Makkah was conquered?
29dc165f41.e: Bilal ﵁ called the adhan from the roof of the Kaʿba on the day of the Conquest.

65b2ba1ebe.q: How long was the truce in the Treaty of al-Hudaybiya?
65b2ba1ebe.e: One of the terms of al-Hudaybiya was that people would be safe for ten years.

c6b1656fcd.q: Which sura did Allah reveal in full to the Prophet ﷺ on his way back from al-Hudaybiya?
c6b1656fcd.e: When the Prophet ﷺ left al-Hudaybiya, Allah revealed Surat al-Fath to him in full.

a8c311c7b3.q: In which month was Makkah conquered?
a8c311c7b3.e: Makkah was conquered with ten nights of Ramadan remaining.

3b70214165.q: Complete the Prophet's ﷺ words at Hunayn: “I am the Prophet, no lie; I am the son of …”
3b70214165.e: At Hunayn the Prophet ﷺ was saying: “I am the Prophet, no lie; I am the son of ʿAbd al-Muttalib.”

00464f1600.q: Which Companion spent a great fortune on the Army of Hardship in the Tabuk campaign?
00464f1600.e: ʿUthman ibn ʿAffan ﵁ spent a great fortune on the Army of Hardship.

7350d29c1c.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ send as leader of the Hajj in the ninth year?
7350d29c1c.e: The Prophet ﷺ sent Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁ as leader of the Hajj that year.

5bd47f1de0.q: In which wife's house did the Prophet ﷺ ask to be nursed in his final illness?
5bd47f1de0.e: The Prophet ﷺ asked his wives' permission to be nursed in ʿAʾisha's ﵂ house, and they agreed.

94c3971f0a.q: Who was the first woman the Prophet ﷺ married?
94c3971f0a.e: The first wife of the Prophet ﷺ was Khadija bint Khuwaylid ﵂.

91061f25c0.q: For how many years did Anas ibn Malik ﵁ serve the Prophet ﷺ?
91061f25c0.e: Anas ﵁ served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years, and he never once said “uff” to him.

ef1f1271c8.q: How many prayers did Allah first prescribe on the night of al-Israʾ before reducing them to five?
ef1f1271c8.e: Fifty prayers were prescribed on the night of al-Israʾ, then Allah reduced them to five.

c73e3bc8a2.q: After the three commanders were martyred at Muʾta, who took the banner and withdrew the Muslims until they were clear of the enemy?
c73e3bc8a2.e: Khalid ibn al-Walid ﵁ took the banner and withdrew the Muslims until they were clear of the enemy.

1e977e375d.q: What is the name of the pledge the Companions gave the Prophet ﷺ under the tree at al-Hudaybiya?
1e977e375d.e: The pledge under the tree at al-Hudaybiya is the Pledge of Ridwan.

d7d95504c7.q: Who advised the Prophet ﷺ at al-Hudaybiya to go out, sacrifice his animal and shave his head so the people would follow him?
d7d95504c7.e: Umm Salama ﵂ advised the Prophet ﷺ to sacrifice his animal and shave his head.

027306c3b0.q: Which Companion found ʿAʾisha, Mother of the Believers ﵂, after she was left behind by the army in the campaign of Banu al-Mustaliq?
027306c3b0.e: ʿAʾisha ﵂ only woke when Safwan ibn al-Muʿattal al-Sulami said “to Allah we return”.

205358bd8e.q: In which sura did Allah confirm Zayd ibn Arqam in what he reported about ʿAbd Allah ibn Ubayy?
205358bd8e.e: Allah confirmed Zayd ibn Arqam in Surat al-Munafiqun.

6e7910ea9e.q: At whose death did the Throne of the Most Merciful shake with joy at the arrival of his soul?
6e7910ea9e.e: Saʿd ibn Muʿadh ﵁ is the one for whom the Throne of the Most Merciful shook with joy at the arrival of his soul.

e34d536248.q: Which Companion wrote a letter to the people of Makkah telling them the Prophet ﷺ was marching on them before the Conquest?
e34d536248.e: Hatib ibn Abi Baltaʿa wrote to the people of Makkah telling them of the Prophet's ﷺ march.

78faa96a80.q: Who gathered Hawazin to fight the Muslims after the Conquest of Makkah, leading to the Battle of Hunayn?
78faa96a80.e: When news of the Conquest of Makkah reached Hawazin, Malik ibn ʿAwf al-Nasri gathered them.

fdb7e6c4b0.q: At Hunayn the Prophet ﷺ told a Companion to call out: “O Ansar! O people of the Tree!” Who was he?
fdb7e6c4b0.e: The Prophet ﷺ told his uncle al-ʿAbbas, who had a loud voice, to call the Ansar and the people of the Tree.

53cb7855e3.q: Which idol did the delegation of Thaqif ask to keep unbroken, a request the Prophet ﷺ refused?
53cb7855e3.e: The delegation of Thaqif asked to keep their idol al-Lat, and the Prophet ﷺ refused.

421879724c.q: Which of these stayed behind from Tabuk without hypocrisy, and then Allah accepted their repentance?
421879724c.e: Murara ibn al-Rabiʿ, Kaʿb ibn Malik and Hilal ibn Umayya stayed behind from Tabuk, then Allah accepted their repentance.

512b4a08eb.q: How many ʿUmras did the Prophet ﷺ perform?
512b4a08eb.e: The Prophet ﷺ performed four ʿUmras: al-Hudaybiya, the make-up ʿUmra, al-Jiʿrana, and the one with his Hajj.

f304a29286.q: Who sent Mariya the Copt, mother of Ibrahim, as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ?
c: Al-Muqawqis, ruler of Alexandria and Egypt
f304a29286.e: Al-Muqawqis, ruler of Alexandria and Egypt, sent Mariya the Copt to the Prophet ﷺ.

458a2220c2.q: In which battle did the Prophet ﷺ take the sword Dhu al-Fiqar as his share?
458a2220c2.e: The Prophet ﷺ took his sword Dhu al-Fiqar at Badr.

f358ee2d1e.q: Who was the Prophet's ﷺ messenger to Heraclius, ruler of the Byzantines?
f358ee2d1e.e: The Prophet ﷺ sent Dihya ibn Khalifa al-Kalbi to Heraclius, ruler of the Byzantines.

2a128d16ff.q: Which Companion looked after the Prophet's ﷺ sandals and put them on for him when he rose?
2a128d16ff.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn Masʿud ﵁ looked after the Prophet's ﷺ sandals and put them on for him when he rose.

c66ce0252c.q: What was the name of the Jewish woman who gave the Prophet ﷺ a poisoned sheep at Khaybar?
c: Sara, freedwoman of Banu ʿAbd al-Muttalib
c66ce0252c.e: Zaynab bint al-Harith, wife of Sallam ibn Mishkam, gave the Prophet ﷺ a poisoned sheep at Khaybar.

763af01f07.q: What was the Muslims' battle cry in the campaign of Banu al-Mustaliq?
763af01f07.e: The Muslims' battle cry at Banu al-Mustaliq was “Amit! Amit!”.

0813f0a675.q: The necklace ʿAʾisha ﵂ went back to look for in the campaign of Banu al-Mustaliq belonged to whom?
0813f0a675.e: ʿAʾisha ﵂ lost a necklace that her sister Asmaʾ had lent her.

b225e02953.q: Who raided the Prophet's ﷺ milch camels at al-Ghaba, leading to the campaign of Dhu Qarad?
b225e02953.e: ʿUyayna ibn Hisn, with Banu ʿAbd Allah ibn Ghatafan, raided the Prophet's ﷺ milch camels at al-Ghaba.

0c33e81879.q: The Prophet ﷺ marched against Banu Lihyan to avenge whom?
0c33e81879.e: The Prophet ﷺ marched against Banu Lihyan to avenge the men of al-Rajiʿ.

a8acc2535e.q: Who led the small band the Prophet ﷺ sent to kill Abu Rafiʿ Sallam ibn Abi al-Huqayq?
a8acc2535e.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAtik led the men who went out, on the Prophet's ﷺ order, to kill Abu Rafiʿ.

de32d61ece.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ put in charge of the vanguard on the day Makkah was conquered?
de32d61ece.e: The Prophet ﷺ put Abu ʿUbayda ibn al-Jarrah over the vanguard on the day of the Conquest.

5ed78701e2.q: In whose house did the Prophet ﷺ bathe on the day Makkah was conquered and pray eight rakʿas?
5ed78701e2.e: The Prophet ﷺ bathed in Umm Haniʾ's house and prayed eight rakʿas, ending each two with salam.

2e2ce0ab1e.q: Who followed ʿIkrima ibn Abi Jahl when he fled to Yemen and brought him back under the Prophet's ﷺ guarantee of safety?
c: His wife Umm Hakim bint al-Harith ibn Hisham
2e2ce0ab1e.e: Umm Hakim bint al-Harith followed her husband ʿIkrima and brought him back under the Prophet's ﷺ guarantee, and he became Muslim.

228130627a.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ leave in charge of Makkah when he set out for Hunayn?
228130627a.e: The Prophet ﷺ left ʿAttab ibn Asid in charge of Makkah, when he was about twenty years old.

d1a4246ee3.q: Which foster sister of the Prophet ﷺ was among the captives of Hawazin, whom he honoured and gave gifts?
d1a4246ee3.e: Al-Shayma bint al-Harith, the Prophet's ﷺ foster sister, was among the captives of Hawazin, and he honoured her.

ba7db1c343.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ make imam of the Thaqif delegation, though he was the youngest of them?
ba7db1c343.e: The Prophet ﷺ made ʿUthman ibn Abi al-ʿAs imam of Thaqif for his eagerness for the Qurʾan despite his youth.

2e86282229.q: About how many Companions heard the Prophet's ﷺ sermon at ʿArafat in the Farewell Hajj?
2e86282229.e: About forty thousand Companions heard the sermon at ʿArafat.

453c2370a1.q: What dowry did the Negus give Umm Habiba on behalf of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
453c2370a1.e: The Negus gave Umm Habiba four hundred dinars as dowry on behalf of the Prophet ﷺ and equipped her.

72ccf04817.q: What was the name of the first horse the Prophet ﷺ rode into battle?
72ccf04817.e: Al-Sakb was the first horse the Prophet ﷺ rode into battle.

55c670dfd1.q: Where did Abu Mahdhura ﵁ call the adhan for the Prophet ﷺ?
55c670dfd1.e: Saʿd al-Qaraz called the adhan in Quba, and Abu Mahdhura in Makkah.

a19d0e5142.q: How many nights after the Prophet ﷺ returned from Tabuk did Allah accept the repentance of the three who stayed behind?
a19d0e5142.e: Allah accepted the repentance of the three who stayed behind fifty nights after the Prophet ﷺ returned.

73cbe12b7f.q: Which grandfather of the Prophet ﷺ dug out the well of Zamzam after it had been buried?
73cbe12b7f.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib dug Zamzam after he was shown its place in a dream.

919f39a431.q: Who was with ʿAbd al-Muttalib when he set out to dig Zamzam, being then his only son?
919f39a431.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib set out with his son al-Harith, who was then his only son.

6bfcd64c2a.q: What did ʿAbd al-Muttalib vow if he had ten sons who grew up to protect him?
c: To sacrifice one of them to Allah at the Kaʿba
To dig a new well in Makkah
To clothe the Kaʿba every year
To feed the pilgrims for a whole year
6bfcd64c2a.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib vowed to sacrifice one of his sons at the Kaʿba if they reached ten.

2b7603e502.q: What was the name of the pact in which Quraysh swore to support anyone wronged in Makkah until justice was restored to him?
2b7603e502.e: Quraysh called this pact Hilf al-Fudul; it was to support the wronged.

c644e0dc72.q: Why was Hashim, the Prophet's ﷺ great-grandfather, given that name?
c: Because he broke bread (for tharid) for his people in Makkah
Because he smashed the idols of Quraysh
Because he was fierce in war
c644e0dc72.e: His name was ʿAmr, and he was called Hashim because he broke bread into tharid for his people.

56b3b2f128.q: What was the original name of Hashim, the Prophet's ﷺ great-grandfather?

507488eab9.q: According to Ibn Ishaq, who was the first male to become Muslim?
507488eab9.e: Ibn Ishaq states that ʿAli ibn Abi Talib ﵁ was the first male to become Muslim.

6337cd3d93.q: Which Companion did the Prophet ﷺ send with the people of ʿAqaba to teach them the Qurʾan and Islam?
6337cd3d93.e: The Prophet ﷺ sent Musʿab ibn ʿUmayr with the people of ʿAqaba to teach them the Qurʾan.

674e83052f.q: Which Companion was shown the call to prayer (the adhan) in a dream and brought it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
674e83052f.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn Zayd ﵁ saw the adhan in his dream, and the Prophet ﷺ ordered it to be called.

a5ce86eca4.q: What did Allah send upon the people of Sabaʾ when they turned away from thanking Him?
a5ce86eca4.e: Allah the Exalted says: “But they turned away, so We sent upon them the flood of al-ʿArim.” (meaning)

9412635b52.q: Who was the man of the Trench (al-Ukhdud), the last of the kings of Himyar?
9412635b52.e: Dhu Nuwas was the last king of Himyar and the man of the Trench.

d756dba03e.q: What church did Abraha build in Sanaʿa to draw the Arabs' pilgrimage to it?
d756dba03e.e: Abraha built al-Qullays in Sanaʿa and wanted to turn the Arabs' pilgrimage to it.

c9e35e82fb.q: Who bought Bilal ﵁ from Umayya ibn Khalaf?
c9e35e82fb.e: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁ bought Bilal from Umayya ibn Khalaf and freed him.

c48210ec58.q: With what did Hamza ﵁ strike Abu Jahl and wound his head when he insulted the Prophet ﷺ?
c48210ec58.e: Hamza struck Abu Jahl with his bow and wounded his head, saying: “Do you insult him when I follow his religion?”

03af3252d9.q: Who was the husband of Fatima bint al-Khattab, ʿUmar's ﵁ sister, both of whom became Muslim before him?
03af3252d9.e: Saʿid ibn Zayd and his wife Fatima bint al-Khattab, ʿUmar's sister, were among the first to accept Islam.

169036e002.q: In his letter, where did the Prophet ﷺ order ʿAbd Allah ibn Jahsh to go and camp?
169036e002.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn Jahsh opened the letter after two days, and it told him to go on until he camped at Nakhla.

98c2fa5414.q: When did the Prophet ﷺ and the polytheists meet at Badr?
c: On Friday, the morning of the 17th of Ramadan
98c2fa5414.e: Badr was on Friday, the morning of the 17th of Ramadan.

9c11009f3b.q: Who was with the Prophet ﷺ in the shelter (al-ʿArish) on the day of Badr?
9c11009f3b.e: Abu Bakr ﵁ was with the Prophet ﷺ in the shelter on the day of Badr.

4fc8f09409.q: To whom belonged the land where the Prophet's ﷺ she-camel knelt, on which his mosque was built?
c: Two orphan boys of Banu al-Najjar, Sahl and Suhayl
4fc8f09409.e: The site of the mosque was a drying yard belonging to two orphan boys of Banu al-Najjar, Sahl and Suhayl.

beac0c245a.q: According to Ibn Ishaq, how many nights of Rabiʿ al-Awwal had passed when the Prophet ﷺ was born?
beac0c245a.e: Ibn Ishaq said: he ﷺ was born on a Monday, twelve nights into Rabiʿ al-Awwal, in the Year of the Elephant.

19abd0d2ac.q: What was ʿAbd Allah ibn Salam's ﵁ name before the Prophet ﷺ renamed him?
19abd0d2ac.e: His name was al-Husayn; when he became Muslim the Prophet ﷺ named him ʿAbd Allah.

221028e0e4.q: Which city was Salman al-Farisi ﵁ from?
221028e0e4.e: Salman said: “I was a Persian man from the people of Isfahan.”

ebfc0d47a2.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say at Badr when he faced Quraysh with a handful of pebbles and threw it at them?
c: “O Allah, fulfil what You promised me”
ebfc0d47a2.e: The Prophet ﷺ threw the pebbles at Quraysh and said, “May the faces be disfigured,” and they were routed.

4b4388e14b.q: What did Bilal ﵁ keep saying while he was tortured in Makkah?
c: “There is no power nor strength except by Allah”
4b4388e14b.e: Under torture Bilal kept saying: “Ahad, Ahad.”

ca397941e9.q: With what did Asmaʾ bint Abi Bakr ﵂ tie up the food bag of the Prophet ﷺ and her father when she forgot to bring a cord?
ca397941e9.e: Asmaʾ undid her waistband and used it as a cord for the food bag.

a441eac854.q: How many months after the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Madinah was the qibla turned to the Kaʿba?
a441eac854.e: The qibla was turned in Rajab, seventeen months after he ﷺ arrived in Madinah.

5ab67a0bb3.q: Who was the Prophet's ﷺ companion in the cave?
5ab67a0bb3.e: Abu Bakr ﵁ emigrated with the Prophet ﷺ and was his companion in the cave.

d6902c611f.q: Which caliph rose to fight the apostates and those who withheld zakat after the Prophet ﷺ died?
d6902c611f.e: When groups of Arabs apostatised and withheld zakat, Abu Bakr al-Siddiq rose to fight them.

2f720c2e2b.q: Who was the first to be called “Commander of the Believers” (Amir al-Muʾminin)?
2f720c2e2b.e: The first to be called Commander of the Believers was ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab ﵁.

4dfd9de4cd.q: Who was the first to date events from the Hijra?
4dfd9de4cd.e: ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab ﵁ was the first to date from the Hijra.

96c6f015e7.q: In whose caliphate was Jerusalem conquered?
96c6f015e7.e: ʿUmar ﵁ marched and took Jerusalem, and gave his famous sermon at al-Jabiya.

a9592da7e3.q: Why was ʿUthman ibn ʿAffan ﵁ called “Dhu al-Nurayn” (Possessor of the Two Lights)?
c: Because he married two daughters of the Prophet ﷺ
Because he was the first to compile the Qurʾan
a9592da7e3.e: ʿUthman was called Dhu al-Nurayn because no one else is known to have married two daughters of a prophet.

55fdd13d6e.q: Which daughter of the Prophet ﷺ did ʿUthman ﵁ marry before the prophethood?
55fdd13d6e.e: ʿUthman ﵁ married Ruqayya, daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, before the prophethood; she died during the days of Badr.

753b74d7d8.q: Who struck ʿAli ibn Abi Talib ﵁ with a sword, so that he was martyred?
753b74d7d8.e: Ibn Muljam ambushed ʿAli ﵁ and struck him with a sword on the forehead, reaching his brain.

5ec76fb465.q: On which day was al-Husayn ibn ʿAli ﵄ martyred?
5ec76fb465.e: Al-Husayn ﵁ was martyred on the day of ʿAshuraʾ at Karbala, also known as al-Taff.

248c5c9bd9.q: Which Umayyad caliph was described as “the fifth of the Rightly Guided Caliphs”?
248c5c9bd9.e: ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz is the righteous caliph Abu Hafs, the fifth of the Rightly Guided Caliphs.

84fd4d8878.q: Who was the first Abbasid caliph?
84fd4d8878.e: Al-Saffah was the first of the Abbasid caliphs.

0f94a9721a.q: With whom did the sheets in which the Qurʾan was compiled remain after ʿUmar ﵁ died?
0f94a9721a.e: The sheets were with Abu Bakr, then ʿUmar, then Hafsa bint ʿUmar ﵃.
